beschreibung:
In this episode of Hang Out with Sean Hannity, former federal prosecutor, congressman, and Fox News host Trey Gowdy sits down for a candid conversation. Trey breaks down his legendary legal career—explaining the relentless drive behind his undefeated record as a prosecutor—and reveals why he ultimately chose to leave Capitol Hill after serving eight years in the House. He opens up about his close brotherhood with Tim Scott, his emotional tribute to his late friend Senator Lindsey Graham, and the real story behind the Benghazi Select Committee investigation. He also gives an inside look at his new book, The Sound of Regret, detailing the tragic real-life homicide case that inspired the story.
